name: codex-task-title-organizer
description: Keep current and recent Codex task titles concise, project-aware, and privacy-conscious.

interface.shortDescription: Project-aware Codex titles at useful checkpoints
interface.longDescription: Bundles a title-standardization skill with a privacy-conscious UserPromptSubmit hook. The hook asks the active Codex turn to set a useful title at prompt 4 and refresh it at prompt 10 only when the work changed materially.
defaultPrompt: Standardize the current Codex task title.
Review and normalize my recent Codex task titles.
Explain how the title checkpoint hook works.
